examples.en: See how care and education bring healthy smiles to millions of children in 80 countries.
examples.reference_zh: 了解关爱和教育如何将健康的微笑带给80个国家的数百万儿童。

examples.en: The Prophet (blessings and peace of Allah be upon him) said: "There should be neither harming nor reciprocating harm."
examples.reference_zh: 先知(愿主福安之)说 : " 不能伤害别人,也不能伤害自己 。 "

examples.en: Upon termination, you must destroy all materials obtained from this Website and all copies thereof, whether made under the terms of these Terms of Use or otherwise.
examples.reference_zh: 条款终止时,您必须销毁所有从本网站取得的资料以及所有相关的拷贝,无论这些资料或拷贝是否是根据这些使用条款的规定或其他规定制作的。
examples.hypothesis_zh: 薛,在在,在都都在,在都都都。

examples.en: The software has a very good user interface and helps to recover different types of files in less time span.
examples.reference_zh: 该软件具有非常良好的用户界面,并帮助恢复在更短的时间跨度不同类型的文件.
